constraints.constraint_text: CHECK(((dataset_start_ns < scoring_start_ns) AND (scoring_start_ns < scoring_end_exclusive_ns) AND (scoring_end_exclusive_ns = dataset_end_exclusive_ns)))

CHECK((((disposition IN ('REAL_OFFICIAL_BAR', 'DERIVED_FROM_OFFICIAL_TRADES')) AND (canonical_bar_identity IS NOT NULL) AND (proof_identity IS NULL) AND (blocking = CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN))) OR ((disposition = 'VERIFIED_NO_TRADE_INTERVAL') AND (canonical_bar_identity IS NULL) AND (proof_identity IS NOT NULL) AND (blocking = CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN))) OR ((disposition IN ('SOURCE_CONFLICT', 'SOURCE_INCOMPLETE', 'UNRESOLVED_GAP')) AND (canonical_bar_identity IS NULL) AND (blocking = CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)))))
